remarks:
Welcome to this 4-bedroom, 2,700+ sq ft colonial in East Amherst’s sought-after Wellington Woods neighborhood. Top-rated Williamsville schools and the shopping, restaurants and conveniences of Transit Road all close by. 

A slate foyer welcomes you home and opens to hardwood floors in a bright, large living room.  Lots of additional spaces to enjoy family time or a quiet cozy corner. Unwind by the wood-burning fireplace in the family room with a bay window, built-ins, and a statement spiral staircase leading to a bonus room. The heated, carpeted 3-season room is ready for you to enjoy morning coffee or evening get-togethers.

The eat-in kitchen offers Corian counters, double ovens, a new electric cooktop and a new refrigerator, with a window overlooking a large, backyard backed by mature trees, a private setting for fall evenings and summer gatherings. Host larger celebrations and holidays in the formal dining room. 

Upstairs there’s room for everyone. You'll find 4 nicely sized bedrooms all with hardwood floors. The primary bedroom has generous closets and an ensuite bath. Additionally you'll find another full bath and attached to one of the bedrooms a huge bonus space, above the family room. Perfect for everything from gathering a scout troop for a craft activity to having a home office or cheering on your favorite sports team, Go Bills! 

A 2 car attached garage means never having to brave the winter and brush off a snowy car.
Peace of mind is built in: basement work completed by Franks in 2011 with transferable warranty, plus a furnace (2017), roof (2021) and windows (2024). The power line from house to pole was replaced in June 2026. Stop by the open house or make an appointment  to come and  see everything this Wellington Woods home has to offer.
